newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds stay calm on high dollar, lower Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European feeds stay calm on high dollar, lower Chicago.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained calm this afternoon as a high dollar and a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening kept buyers sidelined, market sources said.

"We only saw a few nearby trades, some hand-to-mouth buying. The lack of faith in the market, the higher dollar and expectations Chicago soymeal futures could ease kept a firm lid on activity today," one broker said.
Arrived Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $290 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
June Dutch high protein soymeal traded at $329 a tonne fob Rotterdam early in the day and at $325.50 after Chicago moved down this afternoon.
Afloat Malaysian palmkernel expellers changed hands at $99 a tonne cif Rotterdam. Otherwise no trades were reported.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
